The messengers received the commands of Shri Vasishtha 
and taking provision for the journey went to their own houses. 
Then mounting swift horses, accustomed to prolonged travel, 
they started for the kingdom of Kaikeya.

brief.summary_1line: Sage Vasishtha sends secret messengers to summon Bharata from Kaikeya while hiding the king’s death and Rama’s exile.

image_candidates.scene_text: Royal messengers mount swift horses at night outside Ayodhya, carrying gems and silken robes as they depart on a secret mission for Bharata.
The riders pause on the bank of a clear river beside the sacred Satyapayachan tree, bowing in reverence before continuing their journey.
After a long ride through wild lands with lions and elephants, the weary messengers enter the city of Giribraja at nightfall.
